response: I have resolved the issue by adding a [`punycode()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-bl93l4xa/django/utils/encoding.py#L251-L253) helper in [django/utils/encoding.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-bl93l4xa/django/utils/encoding.py) and using it in [`CachedDnsName.get_fqdn()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-bl93l4xa/django/core/mail/utils.py#L16-L19) (as well as [`sanitize_address()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-bl93l4xa/django/core/mail/message.py#L74-L106), [django/core/validators.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-bl93l4xa/django/core/validators.py), and [django/utils/html.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-bl93l4xa/django/utils/html.py)) so that non-ASCII domain names are converted to Punycode (IDNA ASCII-compatible encoding).
